title: Goldman Sachs London Team: Prime Hedge Fund Talent
text:
Are you curious about the increasing trend of talent moving from Goldman Sachs too hedge funds? This article explores the Goldman Sachs’ London emerging markets equities team, a surprising hotspot for hedge fund recruitment. Discover the key individuals making the move, the reasons behind this talent pipeline, and what this means for the future of the Goldman Sachs emerging markets equities team .
Goldman Sachs’ London Emerging Markets Equities Team: A Hedge Fund Hotspot 2025-04-16
The Goldman Sachs emerging markets equities team in London has become a notable source of talent for hedge funds.Several members have recently made the jump, raising questions about what makes this particular team so appealing.
The Talent pipeline The transition from banking to hedge funds is a well-trodden path,but it’s not always a straightforward move. As trading jobs in banks shift towards market making,opportunities in proprietary trading at hedge funds become increasingly attractive. Goldman Sachs’ London-based emerging markets equities team stands out as a consistent provider of talent to the hedge fund world.
Key Departures Several individuals from the Goldman Sachs team have recently joined prominent hedge funds:
Ediz Karahasanoglu: The former head of EMEA emerging markets equities trading is understood to have joined LMR. Declan Browell : An associate who departed for Millennium in Dubai in March. Richard Heath: An executive director who moved to Verition in 2021. Jenagan Ragunathan: A trader who joined Segantii in 2022 before also transitioning to Verition. Riccardo Riboldi: A London partner who went to Schonfeld in 2023. Gavan Deol: Left in June of last year to become an associate portfolio manager at Millennium. samia Zitouni: Departed in 2024 for an undisclosed fund. “something in the Water?” What accounts for this steady stream of talent flowing from Goldman Sachs to hedge funds? Insiders suggest a unique dynamic within the team.
It’s something in the water.
one source noted, adding that once someone leaves for a big fund, everyone else gets motivated to do the same thing.
The Allure of Hedge Funds Hedge funds frequently enough offer opportunities for more aggressive investment strategies and potentially higher compensation compared to customary banking roles. The emerging markets equities sector, in particular, can provide a dynamic and rewarding environment for skilled traders and portfolio managers.
A Team to Watch The Goldman Sachs emerging markets equities team in London has clearly established itself as a breeding ground for hedge fund talent. Whether it’s a unique team culture, access to specific market insights, or simply a confluence of ambitious individuals, the trend is undeniable. The team’s future movements will undoubtedly be closely watched by those in the financial industry.
